name: Power Steering Flush Solution

features.text: Reduces friction and heat that can wear out the pump, valves, and gears.
Enhanced resistance to breakdown due to shearing and system pressure.
Conditions seals and hoses to help prevent cracks and leaks.
Extends system life by reducing wear on internal components.

description: Designed to remove harmful system deposits and impurities. Use it prior to one of the MOC® Power-Steering Service Solutions to help remove depleted fluid and contaminants. Use only in conjunction with a MOC® Power- Steering Fluid Exchanger.
application: Follow the MOC® Power-Steering Fluid Exchanger instructions to perform the exchange process. Dispose of used fluid in accordance with local, state and federal regulations. MOC® Power-Steering Flush Solution #0604 should only be used with a MOC® Power-Steering Fluid Exchanger.
